@s1 stated
  relation "need write access to the analytics bucket"
  role subject "Emre"
  role object "the analytics bucket"
  role topic "the churn model refresh"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "need write access to the analytics bucket"
  role subject "Katarzyna"
  role object "the analytics bucket"
  role topic "the churn model refresh"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "need write access to the analytics bucket"
  role subject "Nnamdi"
  role object "the analytics bucket"
  role topic "the churn model refresh"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "need write access to the analytics bucket"
  role subject "Beatriz"
  role object "the analytics bucket"
  role topic "the churn model refresh"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "have write access to the analytics bucket"
  role subject "Katarzyna"
  role object "the analytics bucket"
  role time "spring"
  role source "the pricing project"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a2 assumed
  relation "be new"
  role subject "Nnamdi"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "have write access to the analytics bucket"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the analytics bucket"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "equal any"
      role subject ?x
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare any
    ?x equal "Emre"
    ?x equal "Katarzyna"
    ?x equal "Nnamdi"
    ?x equal "Beatriz"
  end
